name: Historic Centre of Český Krumlov
description: Český Krumlov is a small town in South Bohemia, Czechia, where the Vltava river curls in tight loops around a huddle of red-roofed medieval houses. Above them rises a castle complex begun in the 13th century, whose Gothic, Renaissance and Baroque parts you can wander through. With about 13,000 residents, it is one of the country's most visited places, and its old streets have survived remarkably intact.
